description.zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

description.zh: IPv6转换服务的描述信息。默认值为空。长度为2~100个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，可包含数字，英文句点（.），下划线（_）和短划线（-）。但不能以http:// 或https://开头。
description.en: The description of IPv6 Translation Service. This parameter is empty by default. It must be 2 to 100 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). It cannot start with http:// or [https://](https://。).
The ID of the IPv6 Translation Service instance.

description.zh: IPv6转换服务实例的名称，默认为实例ID。长度为 2~100个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，可包含数字，英文句点（.），下划线（_）和短划线（-）。但不能以http:// 或https://开头。
description.en: The name of the IPv6 Translation Service instance. The default name is the instance ID. It must be 2 to 100 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). It cannot start with http:// or [https://](https://。).

description.zh: IPv6转换服务实例的地域。 您可以通过调用**DescribeRegions**接口获取地域ID。
description.en: The region of the IPv6 Translation Service instance. You can call the **DescribeRegions** operation to query the most recent region list.

title.zh: 修改IPv6转换服务实例属性

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc modify-ipv6-translator-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token sha1111 --ipv6-translator-id ipv6trans-bp1858ys0000 --name instancename --description instancedescription --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun vpc ModifyIPv6TranslatorAttribute --region cn-hangzhou --Description instancedescription --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Ipv6TranslatorId 'ipv6trans-bp1858ys0000' --ClientToken sha1111 --Name instancename
